structural_source.notice:
# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 寺# (stand straight by) + 手 hand/action indicator → *hold* an object upright → *bear*; *carry*; *own*; *possess*; *have* → *last*; *keep*; *remain edible*; *preserve* (← keep on a lasting basis) → *durability* (← lasting); *be popular* (← have lasting fame). Also, *have someone bring* (← have another carry ← carry), *hold out* (← last), *be in/take charge* (← have firmly in hand); *pay for* (← bear the expense); *be propertied/wealthy* (← possess assets).
握也。从手寺聲。
As per 圭# (cone-shaped) + 手 hand/action indicator → create a cone-shaped object → *hang/be hung from a high place* (← suspend from the top of a tall, cone-shaped object).
畫也。从手圭聲。
穫禾聲也。从手至聲。《詩》曰：“穫之挃挃。”

As per 旨# (ladle) + 手 hand/action indicator → *point to* or *indicate* something with a long, thin object such as a ladle or a *finger* (compare 將) → *designate*; *name*; (in shogi/chess etc.) (make a) *move*. Also, *head for* (← head for a designated point).
手指也。从手旨聲。
As per the top element# as described in 契 (separate) + 手 hand/action indicator → separate by pulling/leading a person away → *pull/lead another by hand* → *carry by hand*.
縣持也。从手㓞聲。

As per 安# (rest in/on) + 手 hand/action indicator → rest a hand on (forcefully) → *press down upon with the hand(s)* → *rub*. Also, *examine/investigate* (← press an object in various spots in examining it).
下也。从手安聲。
給也。从手臣聲。一曰約也。
As per 各# (hard) + 手 hand → hard *punch* → *(fist)fight*; *strike*.
擊也。从手各聲。
𢹬引也。漢有挏馬官，作馬酒。从手同聲。
A variant of 拿 grab → *grab* (a woman) and *drag* (her behind one).
持也。从手如聲。
As per 兆# (split) + 手 hand/action indicator → split (an object/a group) apart → *challenge*; *attempt*; *defy* → *make (romantic) advances*.
撓也。从手兆聲。一曰摷也。《國語》曰：“卻至挑夭。”
手 hand + 劣 weaken → *pluck/pull* an object, thereby weakening the bearer or spoiling the shape → *tear*. Compare 毟.
As per 矣# (come to a stop) + 手 hand/action indicator → cause to come to a stop in order/sequence → *push* (from behind) → *approach*. 挨 is rarely used except in the compound 挨拶 (greeting).
擊背也。从手矣聲。
As per 那# (supple) + 手 hand/action indicator → *rub* to make supple → *shift*.

As per 坐# (circular) + 手 hand/action indicator → *crush* or *break* in flattening objects into a circular shape (compare 摧) → *frustrate* (a plan); *dampen* (spirits) (← crush ambitions). Also, *sprain* (an ankle) (← result of excessive downward pressure).
摧也。从手𡋲聲。

As per 辰# (twitch) + 手 hand/action indicator → twitch/tremble → *shake*; *wave*; *swing*; *sway*; *wag* → *reject*; *jilt*; *stand (someone) up*; *use* (violence); *wield* (power); *display* (one's abilities); *flourish*; *invigorate*; *lean*. Also, *appearance*, *manner of doing* and *pretense* (← impression made by an actor in shaking the hands in gesturing), *give up* and *abandon* (← give up/abandon an undertaking in the face of rejection), *oscillate* and *sprinkle on* (← swing), *tend toward* (← lean), *do well* (← flourish), and *choreography* (← dancer's manner of doing).
舉救也。从手辰聲。一曰奮也。
𢧢持也。从手局聲。
As per 邑# (press) + 手 hand/action indicator → *press one's hands to one's chest*. *Scoop*, *dip* and *ladle/pour out* are borrowed meanings.
抒也。从手邑聲。

As per 廷# (extend) + 手 hand/action indicator → cause an object to extend *straight* → *straighten* → *surpass* → *go ahead*/*pull out* (ahead) of others. Also, *counter* (for spears, candles, guns, palanquins etc.).
拔也。从手廷聲。
長也。从手从延，延亦聲。
As per 免# (draw out of/away from) + 手 hand/action indicator → *draw* (out/away) → *pull* (back) → *saw*; *turn* (on a lathe); *grind*.
As per 夾# (pressed between) + 手 hand/action indicator → press/be pressed between → *insert*; *interpose*; *be caught/sandwiched between*.
俾持也。从手夾聲。
奉也。从手夆聲。
盛土於梩中也。一曰擾也。《詩》曰：“捄之陾陾。”从手求聲。
As per 困# (bind) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *bind*; *tie/truss up*.
裂也。从手赤聲。
臥引也。从手余聲。
As per 足# (compress) + 手 hand/action indicator → compress the hand about an object → *grasp*; *catch*; *seize* → *capture*; *arrest*.
搤也。从手足聲。一曰握也。
引取也。从手孚聲。
As per 寽# as described in 埒 (snatch) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *pluck*; *wrench*; *pick*.
取易也。从手寽聲。
別# separate; divide + 手 hand/action indicator → *divide* → *sell out*; *sell well*; *handle/deal with* (← act as one who divides/distributes a particular product). *Eight* is a borrowed meaning.
方言云：無齒杷。从手別聲。

As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 手 hand/action indicator → *select*/*snatch* a portion of an object (according to which the smaller piece resembles the larger one). Also, *bring/take* along (a portion of a larger object).
自關巳西，凡取物之上者爲撟捎。从手肖聲。
The right-hand element# is 土 earth + 日 (sunlight that softens objects it strikes) → hard earth softening in the sun. 捏 adds 手 hand/action indicator → *knead clay into an object* → *fabricate*.

As per 肙# as described in 絹 (reel/unwind) + 手 hand/action indicator → *remove* silk threads from a silkworm cocoon by reeling/unwinding it → *throw away* → *renounce*. Also, *contribute* (← renounce in favor of another).
棄也。从手肙聲。
As per 甫# (spread) + 手 hand/action indicator → spread the hands/arms and *grasp* an object (compare 把) → *catch*; *grab*; *take hold*; *arrest*.
取也。从手甫聲。
手 hand/action indicator + 歩 here an abbreviated form# of 陟 climb → *make progress* in climbing. Some sources list a variant form eliminating the bottom right stroke as standard.
推也。从手夋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“捘衞侯之手。”
解捝也。从手兌聲。
宛# bend + 手 hand → (flexible) wrist → *arm* → *wrench from/off* → *snatch from* → *tear/break off*. For wrist and arm, compare 腕.
急持衣䘳也。从手金聲。
As per 奉# (spread/extend) + 手 hand/action indicator → *hold an object in both hands* and extend it in a ritual offering → *offer*.
As per 舎# (stretch) + 手 hand/action indicator → stretch the arm in tossing an object away → *toss away*; *abandon*; *give up*; *leave as is*.
釋也。从手舍聲。

捨.explanation: 捨 is used when giving up, abandoning or relinquishing; 舍 remains for dwelling, dormitory and related senses.
捨.example: 舍弃 → 捨棄; 宿舍 → 宿舍
捨.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: As per 戻# (frenetic activity) + 手 hand/action indicator → frenetic twisting motion → *twist*; *turn forcefully* → *wrench*; *screw*; *twirl* → *parody* (← parody that twists reality).
撫也。从手昏聲。一曰摹也。
As per 門# (concealed) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grope for* a concealed object → *stroke* (← motion resembling that made when groping). Compare 摸and 撫.
撫持也。从手門聲。《詩》曰：“莫捫朕舌。”
兩手擊也。从手卑聲。
As per 居# (settle/set in place) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *set*; *place*; *settle down to*; *settle upon*.
𢧢挶也。从手居聲。
卷# curl + 手 hand/action indicator → *curl*; *roll*; *wind* → *turn over* (a playing card); *flip through* (pages).
气勢也。从手卷聲。《國語》曰：“有捲勇。”一曰捲，收也。

捲.explanation: 捲 is used when rolling, winding or curling; 卷 remains for a scroll, volume, paper or examination.
捲.example: 卷起 → 捲起; 试卷 → 試卷
捲.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 垂# hang + 手 hand/action indicator → *strike*/*beat* with a whip (that hangs after striking) → *whip* (v.).
以杖擊也。从手垂聲。
疌# as described in 倢 (nimble) + 手 hand/action indicator → perform nimbly, and *triumph*/*win* → *smart* (← result of performing astutely).
獵也。軍獲得也。从手疌聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人來獻戎捷。”
As per 奈# (press downwards) + 手 hand/action indicator → *press* down (firmly).
As per 念# (contain) + 手 hand → *twist* an object contained between fingers → *nip*; *turn*; *twirl*.
指捻也。从手念聲。
推也。从手委聲。一曰兩手相切摩也。
As per 卒# (compact) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grasp/clutch* (compacting an object) → *pull up* (with a jerk) (← grab and pull up). Compare and contrast 摔.
持頭髮也。从手卒聲。
搯捾也。从手官聲。一曰援也。
As per 欣# (raise) + 手 hand/action indicator → *raise high*; *raise vigorously*.
舉出也。从手欣聲。《春秋傳》曰：“掀公出於淖。”
帚# sweep + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *sweep*.
擇也。从手侖聲。
叕# connect + 手 hand/action indicator → *gather/pick up* objects and connect them.
拾取也。从手叕聲。
As per 受# (receive/accept) + 手 hand/action indicator → *confer* an object on another (= cause another to receive) → *give*; *grant*; *endow*; *award* → *teach*; *instruct*; *initiate*; *blessing*.
予也。从手从受，受亦聲。
As per 卓# (rise above) + 手 hand/action indicator → lift an object high then *shake* or *swing* it (and let it drop).
搖也。从手卓聲。《春秋傳》曰：“尾大不掉。”
As per 咅# (spread) + 手 hand/action indicator → *beat* an object, causing it to split and the contents to spread (compare 擘).
把也。今鹽官入水取鹽爲掊。从手咅聲。
As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 手 hand → raise objects in the *palm* → *deal with* (← take measures precisely suited to the circumstances).
手中也。从手尚聲。
同也。从手昆聲。
As per 奇# (lean) + 手 hand/action indicator → *drag one leg* (and thus be off-balance); drag one leg up to the rest of the body and *come to a stop* → *pull*; *hold back*; *detain*.
偏引也。从手奇聲。
As per 匋# (knead) + 手 hand → knead then take/*scoop* (out) → *take/pull out*; *remove* (from a holder/container).
爪刺也。从手臽聲。

As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → spread in alignment to right and left → line up; arrange; row. Also, *reject*, *exclude* and *eject* (← push off to both sides in rejecting).
擠也。从手非聲。
固也。从手臤聲。讀若《詩》“赤舃掔掔”。
止馬也。从手夌聲。
夜 here a variant form# of 亦 (the armpits) + 手 hand/action indicator → *support* by placing one's hands under another person's *armpits* (compare 扶) → *the sides of the body*. Compare 腋.
以手持人臂投地也。从手夜聲。一曰臂下也。
屈# bend + 手 hand/action indicator → bend to *dig*. Compare 堀.
搰也。从手屈聲。

A variant of 挂 hang → *hang*. In Japanese, the verbs かかる and かける bear numerous meanings that stem directly or indirectly from the concept of "hang." The principal meanings follow. かかる： *hang*; *be covered with/by*; *be splashed*; *be locked*; *be caught*; *be tied (up)*; (of an engine) *start/catch*; *attack*; *be subject to*; *be suspected of*; *be connected/related*; *be involved in*; *call* (out); *be brought up*; *be anxious about*; *depend on*; *take/require* (time); *pay*; *carry* (insurance); (of a play/movie) *be showing/playing* and *set about*. かける： *hang*; *put* (on a stove/fire); *cover*; *sprinkle*; *pour*; *lock*; *fasten*; *grasp*; *catch/snare*; *bind* and *put/set up*. Also, *be in charge*; *weigh*, *fix*, *wear*, *multiply* and *begin to/be on the point of*.
定# fix (straight) in place + 手 hand/action indicator → *fix/settle* (a matter) → *rule*; *regulation*; *law*.

京 here an abbreviated form# of 涼 (flow) + 手 hand/action indicator → fluid motion → *graze* against; * brush by/past/over*; *snatch* → *steal* → *plunder*. Also, *blurry* as well as *husky* (voice) (← indistinct sensations ← graze).
奪取也。从手京聲。本音亮。《唐韻》或作擽。
采# pluck + 手 hand/action indicator → *pluck* → *take in hand*; *take*; *gather* → *pick out*; *select*; *take on*; *employ*.

The relevant seal inscription form is 穴 hole + an element combining 又 hand/action indicator and 火, here an abbreviated form of 炎 (consuming blaze) → poke at a fire in penetrating the deep recesses of the hole where it burns. A later form added 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → search for an object by penetrating a deep recess and groping/fumbling for it → *fumble/feel about for*; *search/look for*; *probe* → *explore*. The right-hand element# of the present form replaces the hand and fire elements with 木.
遠取之也。从手罙聲。
制# control + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → control, particularly by pulling back on → *pull*; *drag* → *pull out* → *restrain*; *hinder*; *suppress*.
所以覆矢也。从手朋聲。《詩》曰：“抑釋掤忌。”
As per 妾# (close proximity) + 手 hand/action indicator → *touch*; *contact*; *join*; *connect*; *associate*; *sexual intercourse*.
交也。从手妾聲。

As per 空# (emptiness) + 手 hand/action indicator → create space between two points, objects or people → *hold back*; *draw in* → *refrain*; *wait*; *await*; *keep from* (← hold back) → *be near at hand*. *Copy/write down*, *note*, *memo* and *a duplicate* are borrowed meanings.
引也。从手空聲。《詩》曰：“控于大邦。”匈奴名引弓控弦。

As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 手 hand/action indicator → push/press down on at length → *infer*; *conjecture*; *suppose*; *assume* (← push one's ideas ← push forward ← press); *recommend*; *support* (← push forward a candidate).
排也。从手隹聲。
奄# cover/conceal + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *cover*/*conceal*.
斂也。小上曰掩。从手奄聲。
As per 昔# (pile) + 手 hand/action indicator → pile (v.) → *place* (in order) → *dispose of*; *deal with*.
置也。从手昔聲。
As per 取# (take hold of) + 手 hand/action indicator → take in hand and *grasp firmly* → *be on night watch* (← grasp/grab offenders).
夜戒守，有所擊。从手取聲。《春秋傳》曰：“賓將掫。”
As per 匊# (wrap about) + 手 hand/action indicator → hold firmly, wrapped in both hands → *scoop* (with the palms); *dip*; *ladle*.

As per 彖# (drooping/pendent) + 手 hand/action indicator → hang heavily from an edge. *Assist*, *aid* and *assistant* are via the idea of assisting/supporting in battle by covering the flanks. じょう refers to the *third of the four ranks* in Japan's Ritsumei system (← assist).
緣也。从手彖聲。
柬# choose; select + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *choose*; *select*.
聚也。从手酋聲。

As per 前# (cut/shear in small increments) + 手 hand/action indicator → *shear*, then *arrange* objects neatly, in close adherence → a *set/unit*; *all*; *line up*; *make objects uniform*; suffix suggesting *every one of*. 揃, like 剪, was devised to replace 前 after the latter underwent its transformation of meanings.
搣也。从手前聲。
兪# remove + 手 hand/action indicator → raise or pull up and *draw out/extract* (compare 抽) → *tease*; *play with* (← hold just out of another person's reach).
引也。从手俞聲。
研# grind; sharpen + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *grind*; *sharpen*. Also, *study* and *research* (← sense of putting one's nose to the grindstone).
As per 癸# (rotate) + 手 hand/action indicator → rotate a measuring implement → *measure* → *method*.
葵也。从手癸聲。
柔# soft + 手 hand/action indicator → soften → *rub/knead* (to soften) → *crumple* → *be confused/disordered*.
As per 苗# (obscure) + 手 hand/action indicator → *trace*/*sketch*/*draw* a rough (= an obscure) outline of a scene → *paint*; *depict*; *describe*.
As per 是# (straight) + 手 hand/action indicator → hold straight out/down → *carry*; *present*; *offer*; *submit* → *hang* (from).
挈也。从手是聲。
As per 臿# (insert) + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *insert*; *fit* → *graft* (a branch); *plant* (a cutting).
刺肉也。从手从臿。
甚# extreme + 手 hand/action indicator → extreme use of the hands → *strike*; *thrust*; *stab*.
As per 咠# as described in 葺 (press) + 手 hand → hands pressed together at the breast in making a greeting → *bow* → *come together*; *assemble*. Also, *yield*.
攘也。从手咠聲。一曰手箸胷曰揖。
摩也。从手盾聲。
撫也。从手扁聲。
昜# rise + 手 hand/action indicator → *raise* fried food out of oil, scattering drops of oil → *elevate*; (deep) *fry*.
飛舉也。从手昜聲。
As per 奐# (draw out of/away from) + 手 hand/action indicator → *change*, *replace*, *exchange* or *substitute* one object for another after drawing the old one out of its position.
易也。从手奐聲。
弇# cover + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *cover*; *cover and hide*.
自關以東謂取曰揜。一曰覆也。从手弇聲。
取水沮也。从手胥聲。武威有揟次縣。
A variant form of 揭 hoist: *pull up/out* → *eradicate* (← pull up/out roots).
拔也。从手匽聲。
屋# cover + 手 hand/action indicator → *grasp/grip* an object, covering it in the hand → *seize*; *hold*. Also, *handle* and *a handful*.
搤持也。从手屋聲。
As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 手 hand/action indicator → *align neatly*; *measure*; *weigh* → *surmise*; *conjecture*.
量也。从手耑聲。度高曰揣。一曰捶之。
捽也。从手卽聲。魏郡有揤裴侯國。
As per 皆# (line up) + 手 hand/action indicator → align people or objects. *Wipe clean* is a borrowed meaning.
束也。从手秋聲。《詩》曰：“百祿是揫。”
As per 曷# (cut off) + 手 hand/action indicator → cut off access/passage by putting up a barrier → *put up*; *hoist* → *run* (an article) → *declare*.
高舉也。从手曷聲。
As per 軍# (circularity) + 手 hand → rotate one's hands → *command*; *wield* → *brandish* (compare 撝). Also, *display* and *throw off*.
奮也。从手軍聲。
引、急也。从手恆聲。
人臂皃。从手削聲。《周禮》曰：“輻欲其揱。”

As per 枼# as described in 葉 (thin/flat/slight) + 手 hand/action indicator → fold a thin object such as a piece of cloth → *fold cloth* → *measure* (← measure length in folding cloth neatly). *Count sticks in divination* is a borrowed meaning.
閱持也。从手枼聲。
As per 爰# (twist an object about a stick) + 手 hand/action indicator → *assist*/*help* the creation of a tool or the completion of a task by twisting an object (whether or not around a stick).
引也。从手爰聲。
Originally 捓, which is 邪# evil + 手 hand/action indicator → meddle (= cause a bad influence) → *tease/make fun of*.
